'''Mellcrawlers''' were [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> They gave off a noxious smell, which worsened when one of the creatures [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Den Dhur]] was familiar with the smell of a mellcrawler that had been dead for a [[Standard week/Legends|week]].<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

During that year, while in the [[Rimsoo Seven cantina|cantina]] of [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] on the planet [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]], Dhur was reminded of the odor of a mellcrawler that had been dead for a week after smelling the [[Tyrusian red ale]] being imbibed by his table companion, an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] named [[Rorand Zuzz]]. The Sullustan reporter remembered finding the smell of a dead mellcrawler to be quite unpleasant.<ref name="MedStar I" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mellcrawler was mentioned in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', a [[2004]] [[Clone Wars multimedia project|''Clone Wars'']] novel written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]] as the first part of the ''[[MedStar Duology]]''.<ref name="MedStar I" />
